title: Bounty — Split bills and track shared expenses
description: Split bills for trips, roommates and meals with Bounty for Android. Track shared expenses, unequal splits and balances, with free core tools and optional Pro.

hero.title: Split bills. Track shared expenses.
hero.description: Trips, shared homes, dinner with friends. Keep track of who paid, how to split it and what’s left to settle.
hero.note: Start with Local or Demo, without an account. Core expense tools are free; Pro is optional.

useCases.title: A trip together
useCases.description: Keep accommodation, transport and everyone’s smaller purchases in one group. See the balance before heading home.

useCases.title: A shared home
useCases.description: Track rent, groceries and household bills with your roommates. Set a different share for each expense when equal isn’t fair.

useCases.title: A meal with friends
useCases.description: Split the whole bill or itemize it by person. Record a settlement when someone pays you back.

tools.title: Split it the way you agreed
tools.description: Use equal shares, exact amounts, percentages, weights or adjustments. Record each person’s payment separately from what they owe.

tools.title: Keep the details with the expense
tools.description: Add notes, attach a receipt or itemize it manually. Keep each currency’s ledger separate and record exchange rates explicitly.

tools.title: Take your records with you
tools.description: Export CSV records or a ledger backup. Backups contain receipt references, so keep original receipt images and PDFs separately.

freeFeatures: Groups, shared expenses and equal or unequal splits
Separate currency ledgers and exchange-rate records
proFeatures: Create or change recurring expense rules
Receipt text scanning on supported Android devices

faqs.question: Do I need an account?
faqs.answer: You can use Local and Demo without signing in. Google sign-in connects your account for subscription access. It does not automatically upload either workspace.

faqs.question: Can friends sync a group together?
faqs.answer: Cloud sharing, invitations and remote receipt transfers are paused. You can keep shared-expense records on your device and export them. Previously saved Cloud ledgers remain viewable and exportable, with pending changes preserved.

faqs.question: Does recording a settlement send money?
faqs.answer: No. Bounty records expenses, balances and settlements you enter. Arrange the actual payment separately, then record it in the app.

faqs.question: What happens when Pro ends?
faqs.answer: Core tools stay free, and existing records and recurring rules remain accessible. Creating or changing recurring rules, advanced insights and supported receipt text scanning require Pro.

faqs.question: How do I manage or cancel Pro?
faqs.answer: Manage the subscription through Google Play. Uninstalling Bounty, signing out or deleting your Bounty account does not cancel renewal.

faqs.question: How can I get help or request account deletion?
faqs.answer: Use Your corner → Request account deletion in the app, or follow the website’s support and account-deletion instructions. Requests are handled manually after ownership verification. Opening an email link does not submit a request or confirm deletion.
